channel.title: OpenIE Research Radio (Zulu)
channel.description: Siyavuyisana nawe ku-OpenIE Research Radio Planetary Digest, esichaza ngezinhlamvu izifundo ezingu-29 zokufinyelela ngokuvulekile ekuqinisekisweni, ukubalwa kwezimali kokusebenza. Ngohlelo lwethu lwesigaba esi-4 sokuhlola-kuqala, amathebulethi wesikhathi esiqhubekayo se-hash, izibalo zokusesha ze-trigram, kanye nenani eliphelele lokuxazulula ukuphatha imibuzo ejwayelekile yasekhaya, ukuvula imodeli enkulu ye-neural kuphela njengendawo yokugcina. On inline 5-volt board shunts nge 0.09 kuya ku-0.11 percent idle drift, unpacking 0.1517 bits-per-ubunzima matricses emuva 32-bit floats wasted 81.86 izikhathi eziningi ibhodi amandla kunazo zonke 8-bit integers, ngenkathi ephaketheni integer logic wakhuphuka 187.49 microjoules gross futhi ukucisha kabanzi cascade amandla 26.58 izikhathi. Ucwaningo lonke luhamba nge-cryptographic hashes, 6-fabric cross-architecture determinism, 24-kilobit Opus low-bandwidth feeds, ukucaciswa okubanzi kwesandi, kanye neCreative Commons Zero plain-language summaries. — AI Persona Disclosure: All nineteen OpenIE Research Radio hosts, skeptics, and bench specialists (Elena, Cecily, Misha, Amara, Priya, Mei, Mateo, Marcus, Nia, Liam, Sean, Devon, Malik, Rohan, Kwame, Tariq, Claire, Arthur, and Kenji) are AI-synthesized OpenIE research personas voiced via ElevenLabs eleven_v4 studio neural voices (with multicultural neural fallback) and grounded strictly in verified Open Interface Engineering artifacts, deterministic pilot receipts, and live open-access literature feeds.

item.title: [Zulu · 90s Briefing] From Ephemeral Inference to Compiled Agency
item.description: Okuqala, i-computing esezingeni eliphakeme ivela ibe inzuzo enkulu kunoma ubani lapho amamodeli abiza kakhulu we-neural esebenza njengendawo yokugcina ngemuva kwethebula lokusesha okude, izibalo zokusesha, kanye nezixazululo ezifanele. Okulandelayo, ukucindezela ubunzima ngaphansi komugqa owodwa kunciphisa ubuchopho, kodwa ukuwasusa emuva kumanani ohlangothini oluhambayo ngesikhathi sokuqhuba kulahlekelwa amandla angama-80 ngaphezulu kwebhodi le-circuit kunesikhathi esisebenzayo se-integer logic efakwe ngokuqondile. Yesibili, i-integer kernel eyodwa ehlolwe nge-cryptographic hashes ikhiqiza impendulo efanayo phakathi kwamaprosesa, amakhadi wezithombe, WebAssembly, umbono wehardware, nama-microcontrollers, ukuyeka ngokushesha uma ubunzima obuhlukile. Ngomsebenzi wokuphatha olinganiselwa kumaphesenti ayishumi nambili, ukuhlola imodeli ye-zero kunqobe amaphuzu angama-61.60 ngephesenti ezinto ezisekelwayo zethuluzi kanye namaphuzu angu-20.80 ngokulingana kwe-Boolean ku-1.41 kuya ku-2.09 microjoules net shunt energy, ngokucophelela ukuhlukanisa ingxenye engu-12.80 yokuvala ikhodi yokukhetha isikhala. Ku-AMD Kria ibhodi le-volt elinhlanu elingenalutho nge-0.09 kuya ku-0.11% yokunyakaza, ukukhishwa kwe-0.1517 amabithi-ngesisindo se-matrices kuya kuma-32-bit floats kwabulala ama-63,335.56 microjoules gross—81.86 izikhathi ezibi kunamanani aphelele we-eight-bit—lapho kufakwa khona inani eligcwele Walsh-Hadamard, okukhethekile-NOR, bit-count, ne-nibble lookup yancipha ibe yi-187.49 microjoules gross ne-10.30 microjoules net. I-kernel eyodwa ye-hash-verified integer ifana ne-bit-for-bit phakathi kwamabhayisikili angama-10 namafayela ayisithupha - iphrosesa, iRadeon 8060S Vulkan graphic, i-processor-graphic ehlukanisiwe, ama-WebAssembly vector, i-Verilog hardware logic, kanye ne-1,444-byte bare-metal microcontroller - ukuyeka ku-single-weight tamper ngaphesheya kwe-1,315 Planetary Digital Well ukunciphisa izithako. Kuphela, isigaba esisodwa sokuhlola ukubhala isikhala sikhuphule amandla we-Kria shunt 26.58 izikhathi eziphelele ne-24.49 izikhathi ze-net, sikhuphule amandla eJetson Thor shunt 16.26 izikhathi, futhi savimbela amahora angama-38.46 ohlelo lwesikhashana sesibili. Zonke izipho zibhalwe ngaphansi kwe-Provenance, Self-Checked—kungaba ngaphandle kokuhlolwa kwe-peer—nge-shunt, chip-counter, okulinganiselwayo, kanye no-unmetered joules agcinwe ngokuqinile ngokuhlukile.

item.title: [Zulu · 90s Briefing] Deterministic Null
item.description: Okuqala, ingxenye enkulu ye-AI benchmarks ishiya iqembu lokuphatha lemodeli yesibalo esingenalutho elingahlola ukuthi yini okutholakele okulula okwamanje kuxazulula. Okulandelayo, ngemisebenzi ye-mathematics nedatha yomlando, ithebula lokuhlola elibandayo lifana ne-cloud AI ezinyangeni eziyisithupha zezivivinyo ezingamashumi. Ngowesibili, kumisebenzi evulekile yokudweba i-AI yahamba phambili, ngenkathi ukubeka ama-cache aqinisekisiwe impendulo ukucisha amandla okuphindiwe amaphuzu amathathu izikhathi ezingu-6. Uma amamodeli amabili ayizinkulungwane eziyizigidigidi-parameter zombili zithola isilinganiso esingu-99% ku-benchmark eyenziwe kahle, ngabe enye yazo ngempela idinga inethiwekhi yengqondo ngesikhathi sokuthathelwa isigqibo? Ngaphandle kweqembu lokulawulwa kwe-zero-model kwi-exam efanayo, akukho muntu ongachaza ushintsho. Sikhiphe ithebula lokubheka inani eliphelele elinezigaba ezisithupha, elingenalutho, eliqinisekisiwe nge-bit-by-bit ku-Rust, Go, Python, Julia, neC plus plus, bese sifaka izibopho zayo zedijithali kumaqiniso asemthethweni weBitcoin calendar ngaphambi kokuba amabheki omphakathi akhiqize amazigidi ezine ezingu-30 zezinkinga ezintsha ezigcinwe ngaphandle. Ngaphesheya amawaka amabili amashumi amane namahlanu ezigidi eziboshwe izinkinga ze-mathematics nedatha basendaweni, amamodeli we-cloud washaya ithebula elibandayo kuphela nge-unindexed umhlinzeki okhuluma, kodwa wakhuphuka kumaphesenti angama-44 kuya ku-95 ngaphambilini ngaphesheya kwezingxenyekazi ezine zobuchwepheshe obubhalwe ngaphandle. Uma izinkinga ze-neural eziqinisekisiwe zibhalwe emuva kwisitolo sokubuka, ubunzima bomsebenzi obuseduze nobukhona bucishe buphinde bubuyele kumodeli yokubiza kanye ne-chip yendawo enekhono ngamaphesenti amathathu amahlanu izikhathi eziyisishiyagalombili.

item.title: [Zulu · 90s Briefing] RCE Compile
item.description: Okuqala, i-real compilers iphula noma yisiphi isivumelwano esichazayo esisodwa, ngakho le cwaningo lichaza i-yardstick yengxenye yesithupha endaweni. Okulandelayo, ubukhulu be-compiler optimization ilahleka amandla angaphambili angaze abuyiselwe emuva ngephesenti elingama-30 lamaphrojekthi wokuhlolwa. Yesibili, ikhodi fingering ngokushintshana indawo reuses kwakha nge zero mix-ups, ukucutshungulwa ukusika Rust ukuhlanganisa amandla amane inani elikhulu. Sithole ukuthi i-compiler ngayinye ikhuphula amafomu ajwayelekile ngenkathi ilandela amandla futhi igcina amagama—eqenjini le-compiler elisemthethweni elinabantu abalishumi nambili. Kuzomsebenzi, akukho okulandela amajoule, akukho okuhlanganisiwe kwekhodi elingaba nombhalo, futhi amafuzzers azenzakalelayo athola amawaka wezinkinga ze-C compiler. Ukuqoqwa okusha njengesilinganiso sengxenye yesithupha sivumela ukuthi silinganise ukubuyiselwa kwemali okuqondile phakathi kwe-kernels engu-20 nezinga lezinto ezisetshenziswayo eziyisishiyagalombili: i-optimised C ishaya iPython ngemuva kwezingu-24 ngaphezu kwamakhulu angu-90, ngenkathi i-Rust runtime libraries ehlukaniswe ikhuphula amandla okwakha ngamaphesenti angama-20. Ukucisha kuphela amagama ashintshayo kwabangela ama-cache angozini ayikhulu elilodwa nesihlanu ukungqubuzana lapho ama-variables amabili eshintsha umsebenzi. Ukufaka amagama ngeDe Bruijn oxhumana namasikhundla uthola i-zero engalungile efana namakhulu amane aqinisekisiwe ama-mutants futhi ubeke phansi i-C kanye ne-Rust rebuild kuze kube yiminyaka engu-408. Zonke izibalo ze-energy zivela kuma-counters we-Linux processor afakwe ngaphakathi ngaphezu kwe-wattmeter yesakhiwo sangaphandle, futhi wonke umbhalo wangaphandle ufaka isitifiketi esicacile.

item.title: [Zulu · 90s Briefing] "AI" Reads Human
item.description: Okuqala, amakhompyutha avame ukushintsha idatha ngefomethi yombhalo obhalwe ngamazinyo kamuntu, okuholela kuma-machines ukuba asebenzise umsebenzi ongeziwe. Okulandelayo, ukufunda umbhalo wokuhlela ofakwe ngaphakathi kwathatha isikhathi esingaphezu kukakhulu kabili kune-chip energy kunalokho ukufunda inani lemishini encane. Okuthathu, ukuchoboza umbhalo obekwe ngezingxenye zegama le-AI kuqhuma amandla angaphezu kwamaphesenti ayishumi nambili kunalokho okucubungula umbhalo ngokwawo. Amafomethi agcwele ama-curly braces, ama-commas, nama-indented spaces afakwe ukuze abantu bangabheka amafayela ngokunethezeka kuma-editors ombhalo. Kodwa-ke, amathuluzi e-AI amanje adlula amazigidi zamarekhodi wokubhala ocacile kusuka kumshini kuya kumshini ngaphandle komuntu obheke njalo. Sibiza le misebenzi engaphezulu nge-impedance tax futhi siyihlola izinsuku ezingu-34 zokuhlela nokuhlukanisa amagama asebenza kuwo wonke amarekhodi ayizigidi eziyisithupha. Ukuqhuba ngayinye yalezi zimo ngaphakathi kwenqubo yomsebenzi ohlukanisiwe kwiprosesa ye-Apple ngokucophelela kwahlukanisa izikweletu ezincane zokuhlela kusuka kumisebenzi ye-laptop engasemva. Ukukhishwa kwe-23-byte binary record kusetshenziswa ama-nanojoules angamakhulu amabili anamashumi ayisishiyagalombili. Umbhalo ojwayelekile we-bracketed usetshenziswa cishe izikhathi ezisithupha ngaphezulu, umbhalo ofakwe ngaphakathi wenziwe ngezikhathi eziyinkulungwane ezimbili nesikhombisa namashumi amane anesithoba ngaphezulu, futhi umbhalo ofakwe ngaphakathi we-Python ocacile wakhipha amandla echips ayizigidi ezimbili namaphesenti ayisishiyagalolunye. Nakuba ukufaka izikhala ezimbili zesizinda esibukekayo ngaphezu kokuphinda kabili i-AI igama-elihlukanisiwe amandla kuya kumashumi ayisishiyagalombili nama-microjoules ngayinye. Gcina amapayipi wemishini yangaphakathi a compact futhi binary, futhi uhlanganise umbhalo kuphela lapho abantu befunda khona.
